verdict_reason: It switched to the getAddress helper but keeps an inaccurate class Javadoc and Given/When/Then comments, a title claiming all mapped fields while the new roles field is never asserted, and fixture literals duplicating IntegrationBase constants.

todos.issue: The class Javadoc (lines 12-15) says 'Cross-org and unknown ids yield 404 not-found problems', but this file has no cross-org test. It also names the route '/{id}' where the path template is '{address-id}', and it is a doc comment on a package-private test class, not a public API. The '// Given' and '// When / Then' comments (lines 20, 23, 42, 45, 54) break the no Given/When/Then rule. This PR removed the same comments from AddressDeleteIT and AddressExpiryIT but left them here.
todos.fix: Must: the file carries no class Javadoc and no Given/When/Then comments, and blank lines separate set-up, action and assertions. One way: delete lines 12-15 and the five Given/When/Then comment lines.

todos.issue: get_shouldReturn200WithAllMappedFields_whenAddressIsLive (line 19) claims every mapped field. It never asserts roles, which this PR adds to AddressResponse (AddressResponse.java:53), or addressLine2 and county. The seeded address (IntegrationBase.addressBuilder) has no roles, addressLine2 or county, so dropping roles from AddressMapper.toResponse would leave this test green.
todos.fix: Must: the title claims only the fields the test asserts, or the test seeds and asserts every AddressResponse field, roles included. One way: seed the address with roles, addressLine2 and county, then assert $.roles, $.addressLine2 and $.county as well.

todos.issue: Lines 27-33 assert the fixture values as literals ('Highland Livestock Ltd', '14 Drover''s Way', 'Inverness', 'IV2 3JH', 'GB', '+44 1463 234567', 'exports@highlandlivestock.example.com'). This PR made IntegrationBase the home of those values (NAME, ADDRESS_LINE_1, TOWN_OR_CITY, POSTCODE, COUNTRY_CODE, PHONE, EMAIL; IntegrationBase.java:65-71), and AddressCrudIT and AddressComplianceIT now assert through those constants. This file keeps a second copy, so the fixture lives in two homes.
todos.fix: Must: AddressGetIT asserts the seeded values through IntegrationBase's fixture constants, and no fixture literal remains in the file. One way: replace each literal on lines 27-33 with NAME, ADDRESS_LINE_1, TOWN_OR_CITY, POSTCODE, COUNTRY_CODE, PHONE and EMAIL.
